ephedrine
Well first of all wow what a rush. I took 2 pills and was feeling very good I was having a good time feeling like I was high on alot of caffeine. Well me and a friend decided to snort one and see what happened. We crushed up the pills and snorted up a line. WOW what a burn I mean I thought I was going to burn my nose off I began crying   it was so harsh. Well when the nose burn went down it felt like a tidal wave was pounding into my heart very very nice feeling.
